gates_must_all_be_true_before_public_lau.requirement: Written lawyer memo covering product classification, USDT-pay, wallet, pay-on-behalf and ToS
Business identity: economic code + Moadian registration; bank account in the entity's own name; no third-party/rented accounts
Payment rail legitimacy: PSP written category approval or documented decision to use only business-account transfers; payer-name matching on
Every active SKU has risk_label + restriction_note; high-risk SKUs require explicit disclosure acceptance
ToS, refund policy, risk disclosure and privacy policy published with version and per-order acceptance record
KYC/AML policy adopted; tiers enforced in code; logs and retention configured; compliance officer named
Sanctions hygiene: address screening on every inbound/outbound USDT transfer; counterparties reviewed in the last 30 days; max float per venue set
Tax set-up: CPA engaged; VAT base decided; Moadian invoices emitted; VAT collected held in IRT
No marketing claim of being licensed/legal/CBI-approved unless true; Enamad shown only if issued; no 'dollar/USDT exchange' wording
Kill switches work per SKU, per payment rail and for USDT payment; staff roles and dual control on card-detail reveal
USDT payment from Iran-resident customers and customer wallet cash-out are OFF unless the lawyer memo explicitly clears them

pause_triggers_any_one.trigger: Any notice, summons or information request from FATA, a prosecutor, the CBI or the Tax Organization
pause_triggers_any_one.action: Pause affected flows, preserve logs (legal hold), involve counsel; cooperate lawfully
Stop selling via that rail; do not reroute through third-party accounts; follow bank/PSP procedure

pause_triggers_any_one.action: Pause treasury flows and dependent SKUs; re-screen; consult counsel; follow customer refund tiers

pause_triggers_any_one.action: Pause that SKU, notify affected customers, apply risk-label refund tiers

pause_triggers_any_one.action: Pause the SKU; get legal advice before resuming

items.mitigations: Address screening; venue diversification; just-in-time float; float cap per venue; contingency fund

items.risk: Receiving funds from fraud victims (triangular fraud) or third parties; account blocked

items.risk: Product classified as unlicensed FX/crypto brokerage or payment service (card top-up, wallet, USDT-pay, pay-on-behalf)

items.risk: Platform used as conduit for laundering or fraud proceeds

items.risk: Card issuer / AI vendor suspends accounts, customers lose value
